description: TrackGleam helps musicians, producers, podcasters and AI-music creators finish songs for release. Share a track or its numbers and get a plain-English read of what is holding it back - loudness versus streaming level, clipping, muddy low mids, harsh highs, stereo problems - with practical targets for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube and TikTok. When a tool can do the job, the plugin gives you a TrackGleam link that opens with a suggested starting style: free automatic mastering with WAV and MP3 downloads, a vocal-over-a-beat mixer, a Spotify Canvas maker, a music visualizer for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, a cover art maker and release-check tools. TrackGleam processes your audio in your own browser; your song is not uploaded. The plugin does not master or export files inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: How loud should I master my song for Spotify?
My Suno song is way quieter than other songs. How do I fix it?
I have a beat and a vocal recording. How do I put them together and master it?
